workshop.title: 辨时间、筛条件、看变化
workshop.instruction: 先圈出原句的时间和动作要求，再筛选条件卡、比较水的外观变化。

items.label: safely：safely到达是在天黑前还是之后？
items.prompt: safely到达是在天黑前还是之后？
items.material: We reached the campsite safely before dark.
items.reason: safely修饰reached，说明这次安全到达。reached是过去动作，before dark保留天黑前的时间条件。不能写成天黑后，也不能把一次经历扩大成所有路线一直安全。safe加ly构成safely，保留e。

wordDecision.prompt: safely到达是在天黑前还是之后？

recordSelection.title: 天黑前安全到达营地

rows.label: 这次天黑前安全到达营地
rows.text: We reached the campsite safely before dark.

rows.label: 天黑后才到营地
rows.text: We reached the campsite after dark.

rows.label: 所有营地路线一直都安全
rows.text: Every route to every campsite is always safe.

recordSelection.hint: 保留已到达、天黑前和这次经历。
recordSelection.wrong: 选天黑前安全到达，不反转时间或扩大范围。

options.text: We arrived safely at the campsite before it became dark.
options.reason: 保留安全到达、营地和天黑前。

options.text: We arrived at the campsite only after dark.
options.reason: 反转before dark。

options.text: Every route to every campsite is always safe.
options.reason: 一次安全到达不能扩成所有路线永远安全。

items.label: quietly：quietly修饰动作，还是保证结果？
items.prompt: quietly修饰动作，还是保证结果？
items.material: Close the door quietly so the baby can sleep.
items.reason: quietly修饰close，要求关门时轻一点。so the baby can sleep说明目的，不能改成把宝宝吵醒，也不保证宝宝已经睡着。这里练读文字含义，不以静态画面代替声音辨听。quiet加ly构成quietly。
items.hint: close quietly；so...can...；目的不等于已实现。

wordDecision.prompt: quietly修饰动作，还是保证结果？

recordSelection.title: 轻轻关门，让宝宝能睡觉

rows.label: 要求轻声关门，让宝宝能睡觉
rows.text: Close the door quietly so the baby can sleep.

rows.label: 要求大声摔门吵醒宝宝
rows.text: Slam the door loudly to wake the baby.

rows.label: 保证宝宝已经睡着且不会醒
rows.text: The baby is already asleep and cannot wake up.

recordSelection.hint: 保留动作要求和目的，不补保证结果。
recordSelection.wrong: 选轻声关门的要求，不反转或补已睡着。

options.text: Close the door with little noise to let the baby sleep.
options.reason: 保留轻声关门的要求及目的。

options.text: Slam the door loudly to wake the baby.
options.reason: 反转quietly和目的。

options.text: The baby is already asleep and will certainly stay asleep.
options.reason: can sleep表达目的或可能性，不保证已睡着或永不醒。

items.label: loudly：是谁使招牌大声作响？
items.material: The wind made the loose sign rattle loudly.
items.before: The wind made the loose sign rattle
items.reason: loudly修饰rattle，表示大声作响。made the loose sign rattle说明风使松动的招牌响起来，made后接不带to的动词原形。原句没有分贝数，画面也不能证明实际声音大小。

recordSelection.title: 风使松动的招牌大声作响

rows.label: 风使松动的招牌大声作响
rows.text: The wind made the loose sign rattle loudly.

rows.label: 无风时招牌没有任何声音
rows.text: The sign made no sound in still air.

rows.label: 给出了准确分贝数
rows.text: The sentence gives the exact sound level in decibels.

recordSelection.hint: 保留风的作用和作响，不补音量数值。
recordSelection.wrong: 选风使招牌响，不改成无声或补分贝。

options.text: The wind caused the loose sign to rattle with a loud sound.
options.reason: 保留wind的原因和loose sign的声音。

options.text: The loose sign made no sound in still air.
options.reason: 反转声音，并删掉风的作用。

options.text: The sentence gives the sound level in decibels.
options.reason: loudly没有给出分贝数。

items.label: clearly：clearly要求怎样读路线说明？
items.material: Speak clearly when reading out the directions.
items.reason: clearly修饰speak，要求表达清楚。when reading out the directions保留朗读路线说明的场景；read out表示大声读出。不能改成含糊不清，也不说明已经读完或每个人都理解。文字任务不评定真实口语清晰度。
items.hint: speak clearly；read out；指令不是已完成报告。

recordSelection.title: 朗读路线说明时说清楚

rows.label: 要求朗读路线说明时说清楚
rows.text: Speak clearly when reading out the directions.

rows.label: 要求含糊地读让人听不懂
报告已经读完且人人理解
rows.text: Everyone has already heard and understood the directions.

recordSelection.hint: 保留说清楚的要求，不补完成或理解结果。
recordSelection.wrong: 选朗读时说清楚，不改成含糊或已完成。

options.text: Read the directions aloud in a way people can understand.
options.reason: 保留清楚表达与朗读路线说明的场景。

options.text: Mumble the directions so nobody can understand.
options.reason: 反转clearly。

options.text: The directions have already been read and understood by everyone.
options.reason: 要求说清楚不等于已经读完且所有人都懂。

items.label: properly：unless说明必要条件，还是一定成功？
items.prompt: unless说明必要条件，还是一定成功？
items.material: The gate will not lock unless it closes properly.
items.before: The gate will not lock unless it closes
items.reason: not...unless表示如果不满足条件，就不会发生主句动作。门若没有关好，就锁不上；但这句话没有保证只要关好就一定能锁上。另给条件卡只检查句子的逻辑，不操作或判断实际门锁。
items.hint: not...unless；必要条件不等于充分保证。

wordDecision.prompt: unless说明必要条件，还是一定成功？

gateCondition.title: 哪些条件卡不与原句矛盾？
gateCondition.hint: 另给虚构门锁条件卡：圈出原句允许的情况，不推断真实门锁功能。
gateCondition.wrong: 没关好却锁上与原句矛盾；关好只是必要条件，不能排除关好仍锁不上的情况。

options.text: If the gate does not close properly, it will not lock.
options.reason: unless在否定主句后给出必要条件。

options.text: Closing properly guarantees that the gate will lock in every case.
options.reason: 必要条件不能自动推成充分保证。

options.text: The gate can lock while it remains improperly closed.
options.reason: 与not...unless的条件相矛盾。

items.label: finally：finally found在什么位置？
items.material: We finally found the path behind the hedge.
items.after: found the path behind the hedge.
items.reason: finally在这里表示经过寻找后终于找到。found是find的过去式，behind the hedge是树篱后面，不能改成前面或从未找到。原句没有交代寻找的准确时长。

recordSelection.title: 终于找到树篱后的小路

rows.label: 终于找到树篱后的小路

rows.label: 从未找到树篱前的小路
rows.text: We never found a path in front of the hedge.

rows.label: 给出了寻找的准确时长
rows.text: The sentence gives the exact search duration.

recordSelection.hint: 保留终于找到与树篱后，不补时长。
recordSelection.wrong: 选终于找到后面的小路，不反转结果或位置。

options.text: We found the path behind the hedge at last.
options.reason: finally保留终于找到，behind保留树篱后的位置。

options.text: We never found a path in front of the hedge.
options.reason: 反转找到并把behind改成in front of。

options.text: The sentence states the exact search duration.
options.reason: finally没有给出具体花了多久。

items.label: eventually：eventually与again分别保留什么？
items.material: The water eventually became clear again.
items.reason: eventually表示经过一段时间后最终，became说明变化，again说明又恢复清澈。不能写成一直浑浊，也没有给出准确经过多久。另给对比图只显示浑浊与清澈的外观；原句没有说明净化过程或是否能饮用。

art.alt: 虚构外观对比：左罐水浑浊，右罐水清澈；不代表实际净化过程或饮用判断。

options.text: After some time, the water became clear once more.
options.reason: eventually保留经过一段时间后的结果，again保留恢复清澈。

options.text: The water remained cloudy throughout.
options.reason: 反转became clear again。

items.label: recently：recently learned说明什么时候学会？
items.prompt: recently learned说明什么时候学会？
items.material: I have recently learned how to mend a puncture.
items.after: learned how to mend a puncture.
items.reason: recently表示最近，have learned是现在完成时，说明最近学会了方法。how to mend a puncture是怎样补胎，不能读成从没学过，也没有报告已经修好所有轮胎。recently也可与一般过去时连用，要看具体语境。
items.hint: have recently learned；how to do；学会不等于所有任务已完成。

transfer.stem: Which notes match the camp notebook?
transfer.passage:
Notes from the school camp
We reached the campsite safely before dark. At the entrance, a loose sign rattled loudly in the wind. Our teacher asked us to speak clearly when reading out the directions to the rest of the group.
A note beside the gate read, "The gate will not lock unless it closes properly." We copied it into our notebooks for the next language activity.
After leaving our bags in the main building, we looked for the footpath. We finally found the path behind the hedge. In a separate observation activity, we watched a jar of cloudy water. The notebook entry said, "The water eventually became clear again."
A family was staying in the next room. We were asked to close the door quietly so the baby could sleep. While we arranged our equipment, I told my classmate that I had recently learned how to mend a puncture. She asked me to explain the method in our next class discussion.

options.text: They arrived before dark; proper closing is necessary for locking; the water became clear again after some time.
They arrived after dark; proper closing guarantees locking; the water stayed cloudy.
They arrived before dark; proper closing guarantees locking; the water became clear again after some time.
They arrived before dark; proper closing is necessary for locking; the water stayed cloudy.

answer.display: They arrived before dark; proper closing is necessary for locking; the water became clear again after some time.

explanation.strategy: 分开核对时间、必要条件和变化结果，不能把unless读成一定成功。

steps.text: before dark保留天黑前；not...unless保留关好的必要条件。
steps.reason: 不能反转时间，也不能补成只要关好就必定锁上。

steps.text: eventually became clear again保留最终又变清。
steps.reason: 不能改成始终浑浊；没有准确等待时长。

distractors.reason: 反转到达时间，把必要条件改成保证，还反转水的变化。
把必要条件误读成关好就一定锁上。
把最终又变清反转成始终浑浊。
